title: Resident service is a thin composition loop
summary: AlchemyAutobuildService discovers candidates through AlchemyInbox, rechecks terminal receipts, calls the orchestrator, and records terminal evidence. Planning, transport, execution and publication remain outside the daemon.
invariants: The service does not own Git branch discovery rules.
The service rechecks receipt immediately before work to close scan races.
Inbox conflicts become terminal ERROR evidence rather than killing the daemon.
Syntax/error/failure conditions are converted to terminal ERROR receipts.
runForever is runOnce plus bounded polling; domain behavior remains in components below it.

provenance.claim: Thin runOnce/runForever loop and receipt recheck.
PASS/FAIL/ERROR orchestration and terminal evidence handling.
